content: LIBERO's own lifelong/configs/eval/default.yaml pins max_steps: 600 (used across all task suites in the original benchmark repo/codebase this project forks). External literature reports suite-specific horizons in some derivative works (e.g. 256 for Spatial, 512 for Long) but the project's own forked LIBERO config uses a flat 600 for all suites -- use the project's own value for consistency with existing code.
